concept: One line at the bottom of a phone screen confirming what just happened, usually with Undo, one at a time.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a dark grey bar pinned to the bottom edge with a coloured action (Material snackbar)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a grey slab and a coloured action bring a hue and ignore the glass

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a level-4 pill at the bottom centre, blurred like every pane

derivation.consequence: corners are continuous and nest, so an inner surface's radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them and a pane inside a pane reads as inside it; controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: a full pill because it carries one line and one action, held near the thumb

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: it rises a short way, settles and leaves by fading or a swipe down

options: A level-4 pill at the bottom
variants.picked: A level-4 pill at the bottom
variants.reason: A sits at thumb reach as a pane of the stack. B is a slab with a hue. C is far from the thumb that just acted.

viewport.why: the bottom centre of the screen, with the overlay margin

bar.why: a level-4 pill holding one line and one action

message.why: one line of body text saying what happened

action.why: one action with a 44px target, usually Undo

previewViewport.why: in a preview the snackbar sits in place in its parent instead of the bottom of the screen

data-state=open.why: it rises and settles, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-state=closed.why: it fades out, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-swipe=end.why: a swiped snackbar fades out, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-swipe=move.why: it follows the finger while swiped down, the same in every theme and on every scene

hover.why: the action tints under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

focus-visible.why: the focus ring on the action, the same in every theme and on every scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the pill, the same in every theme and on every scene

empty.why: an empty region takes no room and catches no presses, so it never blocks the page under it

@rise.why: rises a short way and settles, the same in every theme and on every scene

@fade.why: fades out, the same in every theme and on every scene
